description.value: Copper Fern Guest House is a self-contained 780 sq. ft. suite on a private lane just five minutes from downtown Courtenay in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. Hosts Chris and Molly are long-time local residents who greet guests with homemade muffins, granola, and fresh eggs and can point cyclists toward favourite trails, beaches, and restaurants. The suite is designed to be wheelchair accessible and sleeps up to four, offering a quiet garden retreat away from traffic.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, well-reviewed self-contained suite near Courtenay with a laundry room and fibre-optic/wireless internet clearly listed as amenities. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, tools, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site; 'Private Off-street Parking' refers to vehicle parking only. A second phone number (250-650-7115) appears prominently on the website but is absent from the OSM record.
concerns: Website prominently lists a second phone number (250-650-7115) not present in the OSM record.
No mention of secure bike storage anywhere on the website; 'Private Off-street Parking' appears to refer to vehicle parking only.
Street address not explicitly confirmed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active accommodation in a prime Vancouver Island cycling corridor, but neither the website nor OSM mentions any form of secure bike storage — the key required WWC criterion. Direct contact with hosts is needed to determine whether a secure storage arrangement exists.
